  • Technical leadership: Provide technical guidance, drive project execution, and contribute to building scalable data pipelines and prototypes.
  • Product development: Help improve the product by contributing to solution development, keeping up with fraud prevention trends, and creating generalized product enhancements.
  • Communication: Clearly communicate complex findings and strategies to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Key skills and qualifications

  • Programming: Strong proficiency in Python, including scientific stack libraries (NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn) and experience with distributed computing tools like PySpark.
  • Machine Learning: Expertise in machine learning concepts and algorithms.
  • Data Manipulation: Experience with data cleaning, feature engineering, and building scalable data pipelines (e.g., with Airflow and Trino).
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to explain complex ideas to various stakeholders.
  • Analytical: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to tackle complex financial crime challenges.

Education: A degree in a quantitative field like Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related area is often required.

Why Matrix

Matrix is a global, dynamic, fast-growing technical consultancy leading technology services company with 13000 employees worldwide. Since its foundation in 2001, Matrix has made more travelers and acquisitions and has executed some of the largest, most significant. The company specializes in implementing and developing leading technologies, software solutions, and products. It provides its customers with infrastructure and consulting services, IT outsourcing, offshore, training and assimilation, and Ves as representatives for the world's leading software vendors. With vast experience in private and public sectors, ranging from Finance, Telecom, Health, Hi-Tech, Education, Defense, and Secu city, Matrix's customer base includes guest organizations in Israel and a steadily growing client base worldwide.

We are comprised of talented, creative, and dedicated individuals passionate about delivering innovative solutions to the market. We source and foster the best talent and recognize that all employee's contributions are integral to our company's future.

Matrix- success is based on a challenging work environment, competitive compensation and benefits, and rewarding career opportunities. We encourage a diverse work environment of sharing, learning, and ceding together. Come and join the winning team! You'll be challenged and have fun in a highly respected organization. title: HR Training Analyst
description:
Position: HR Training Analyst

Location: Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro


About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.


Job Purpose

The HR Training & Personnel Logistics Analyst is responsible for ensuring full compliance of offshore personnel with mandatory training requirements, managing training logistics, and maintaining accurate certification records in DRAKE System.

The role also supports HR strategy implementation, training governance, personnel logistics coordination, and operational workforce readiness in alignment with corporate policies and project needs.


Key Responsibilities

Ensure that all offshore personnel hold valid mandatory training and certifications required for offshore deployment;

Coordinate all logistics arrangements for trainings scheduled in the DRAKE System;

Maintain strict control and timely updates of training and certification records in DRAKE;

Provide HR expertise in developing and implementing training-related policies, processes, and improvement actions according to business needs;

Interpret, apply, and uphold corporate policies and legal requirements with strong customer focus and best practices;

Apply an integrated approach when managing the employee mandatory training cycle (training matrix, gap analysis, deviation notices, certifications, training providers, and budget control) to effectively support Projects and Operations;

Monitor and support the local execution of HR Training policies, procedures, and processes;

Assist in managing the training budget, including creation and follow-up of Purchase Requisitions (PRs) for all training-related expenses;

Coordinate feedback from personnel regarding training provider performance and recommend improvements to management;

Support audits and evaluations of training service providers;

Provide operational support to the Personnel Logistics team, including weekend on-call coverage and emergency demands when required;

Control operational activities related to personnel departure, mobilization, and allocation.


Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field;

Previous experience in offshore operations, oil & gas, or maritime environment preferred;

Experience managing training matrices and certification control systems (DRAKE knowledge is an advantage);

Knowledge of Brazilian labor and maritime regulations is desirable;

Fluent English (minimum intermediate level);

Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities;

Proactive profile with strong interface capability between HR and Operations.


Benefits

Meal and food allowances;

Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, no co-pay);

Life Insurance;

Annual Bonus;

Private Pension Plan;

Childcare Allowance.


Note

This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
UI/UX Designer

Full-Time | Brazil (Hybrid) | Mid–Senior Level


About the Role

We build technology products for companies that are reshaping how industries operate. Our design team sits at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and user research, and the work we do ships to real users.


This is not a purely visual design role. Designers here influence product direction, collaborate closely with engineers and product leaders, and help define how complex systems should actually work.


We are looking for a UI/UX Designer who can move fluidly between ambiguous discovery work and pixel-precise execution. You will partner with product managers, engineers, and client stakeholders to design experiences that are strategically sound and deeply usable.


What You'll Do

• Own design end-to-end for one or more product workstreams, from research and wireframes through final developer handoff

• Facilitate discovery sessions with clients and internal teams to clarify problems before jumping into solutions

• Produce high-fidelity prototypes and detailed design specifications that engineers can build from with minimal iteration

• Conduct usability testing and translate insights into actionable design improvements

• Contribute to and help maintain shared design systems across multiple products

• Present design rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership

• Collaborate with product managers to define success metrics for design decisions and evaluate outcomes after launch

What We're Looking For


Must-Have Experience

• 3+ years of product design experience, ideally within a startup, consultancy, or fast-paced product environment

• Strong portfolio demonstrating systems thinking and problem solving, not just visual design

• Advanced proficiency with Figma including components, auto-layout, variables, and interactive prototyping

• Experience designing for both web and mobile platforms with awareness of technical constraints

• Ability to communicate design decisions in terms of user impact and business value

• Comfortable working in ambiguous environments where problems are not fully defined


Nice to Have

• Experience designing products for enterprise or B2B users

• Familiarity with front-end development concepts such as HTML, CSS, or React fundamentals

• Experience with service design or end-to-end journey mapping for complex products

• Experience building or scaling a design system from the ground up


How We Work

Our teams operate in short delivery cycles with tight collaboration between design, product, and engineering. We prioritize fast decision making, direct communication, and high ownership.


We partner with organizations across industries including healthcare, financial services, logistics, and enterprise software. Projects range from building new products from scratch to modernizing complex legacy platforms.


What You'll Get

• Competitive base salary with performance-based compensation

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits

• Flexible remote-first environment with optional in-person collaboration

• Exposure to a wide range of industries and product challenges

• A design-focused team that values craft and pushes each other to produce exceptional work

title: Research Engineer, RL Environments
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, RL Environments to help design and build frontier-quality RL environments, reward systems, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to translate their post-training and RL goals into concrete environment specs — designing tasks with verifiable outcomes, building reward and verifier systems, and ensuring environments are robust against reward hacking and distribution collapse.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building deep learning or RL systems — especially where strong results depended on environment design, reward engineering, training infrastructure, or rigorous evaluation.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and build RL environments and verifier systems

  • Work with customer researchers to translate RL training goals into environment specs: target capabilities, task distributions, difficulty curves, and success criteria.
  • Design task suites with verifiable outcomes — single-step and long-horizon workflows with clear ground-truth signals.
  • Build reward functions, verifiers, automatic validators, and evaluation harnesses that provide reliable training signal and resist gaming.
  • Define environment interfaces: APIs, tool schemas, state abstractions, database schemas, and simulator-like dynamics that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build quality systems that keep environments robust at scale

  • Audit environments and trajectories for subtle failure modes: reward hacking, leakage, ambiguity, distribution shifts, and degenerate task distributions.
  • Implement automated validation: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, difficulty controls, and diversity monitoring.
  • Develop synthetic task generation and augmentation pipelines: programmatic generators, controlled perturbations, hard negatives, and scenario templating with diversity constraints.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals reflecting customer-intended model capabilities.
  • Produce analysis connecting environment design choices to training outcomes: pre/post comparisons, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which environment and reward attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run RL or fine-tuning experiments (or partner with research) to validate that your environments produce measurable improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops based on trajectory analysis and quantitative signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task and environment creation efforts.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of experience building or improving deep learning or RL systems where environment design, data quality, or reward engineering mattered materially.
  • Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning — any of: environment/gym development, reward design, PPO/GRPO/DPO, trajectory collection, or RL training infrastructure.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good training task: verifiability, appropriate difficulty, resistance to shortcuts, and realistic constraints.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented in diagnosing subtle quality issues and failure modes in data or environments.
  • Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning RL training objectives into concrete environment specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, verifier training, reward modeling, or constitutional AI methods.
  • Experience building custom gym environments, simulators, or distributed RL training systems.
  • Agentic evaluation: tool use, multi-step workflows, long-horizon tasks, trajectory analysis.
  • Systems thinking: ability to simulate an application's API and data schema and design tasks reflecting real-world constraints.
  • Experience with LLM fine-tuning at scale.


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

title: StarRocks Database Engineer (DBE) - Remote
description:
Database Engineer (DBE) – Enterprise Open-Source Support

Location : Remote (preferred South / Central America or US TIme Zones)

Department : Engineering - Open Source Database support

Reports to: CTO / VP Engineering


About Deep.BI

We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‑source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.Our customers run mission‑critical, high‑volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We’re a small, world-class expert, remote‑first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.


Role Overview

As a Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting StarRocks clusters. You’ll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.


While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of DevOps, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4): Diagnose and resolve complex issues in StarRocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions)
  • Performance optimization: Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load.
  • Architecture & design support: Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches.
  • Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA: Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.
  • CVE patching: Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.
  • Knowledge sharing: Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.
  • Optional / nice-to-have:
  • Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation)
  • Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.


Requirements

  • 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting StarRocks clusters in larger scale production (not just querying or dashboard usage; no PoCs) 
  • Proven experience with query optimization,indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines .
  • Solid knowledge of distributed systems concepts (consistency, replication, failover, scaling)
  • Hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery setups
  • Comfort with Linux systems, networking basics and SQL .
  • Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure (incident scenarios)
  • Strong English language communication skills — able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing
  • Bonus: Experience with Apache Druid, ClickHouse, TiDB, Apache Cassandra, or similar databases
  • Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM).
  • Bonus : Contributions to open-source database projects.


What we offer

  • Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies at enterprise scale .
  • Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases, communities.
  • Competitive salary 
  • Support for conference travel and OSS contributions
  • Flexible contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.


Location & working style

  • Remote‑first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.
  • Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

title: Junior Sales Closer (Consultor de Vendas)
description:
Localização:  Barra da Tijuca, RJ


Tipo de vaga:  PJ (Pessoa Jurídica), tempo integral, R$ 6.000,00 fixo + comissões ilimitadas  


Sobre a Ótima Energia

Não somos apenas mais uma corretora de energia empurrando uma única solução. Na Ótima Energia, existimos para trazer clareza e confiança a um mercado confuso. As empresas brasileiras pagam caro pela energia não porque faltam opções, mas porque o mercado é barulhento: ofertas confusas, contratos ambíguos e vendedores empurrando o que paga a melhor comissão para eles.


Nós substituímos isso por uma abordagem neutra e baseada em dados. Nosso sistema de IA, o ECOS™, analisa os três mercados de energia (ACR, ACL, GDL) e diz às empresas exatamente onde elas economizarão mais, com zero conflito de interesses.


Nossa promessa: Sua energia. Sua escolha. Sua economia.  Estamos crescendo rápido. E precisamos de pessoas que amam vencer.


A Função: Closer (Consultor de Energia)

Este não é um trabalho para quem precisa que as coisas sejam fáceis. Este é um lugar para quem:

  • É um talento de alto potencial finalmente pronto para ser liberado.
  • Tem habilidade comprovada e busca o palco à altura da sua ambição.
  • Sabe o que é ralar e quer ralar por algo real.
  • Faz as pessoas se sentirem bem apenas por estarem no mesmo ambiente.
  • É um doador de energia, não um sugador.


Este Trabalho NÃO É Para Você Se:

  • Você trata a empatia como uma tática em vez de um traço de personalidade.
  • Você fala muito, mas tem zero disciplina para sustentar o que diz.
  • Você é uma \"pessoa de pessoas\", mas desmorona ao ser rejeitado.
  • Você ama o holofote, mas odeia a disciplina necessária para se manter nele.
  • Você está esperando por um \"golpe de sorte\" em vez de trabalhar mais que todos na sala.
  • Você tem \"100% de potencial\", mas só entrega 50% de esforço quando ninguém está olhando.


Quem Você É


Qualidade Por que isso importa


Você ama vencer | Fechar negócios traz uma sensação imbatível. Você é competitivo e acompanha seu placar.


Você é mentalmente forte | A rejeição não te abala. Você sabe que o \"não\" é apenas um número no caminho para o \"sim\".


Você é implacável | Você faz 60 ligações. Depois 80. Depois 100. Você não para até o trabalho estar feito.


Um charme natural | As pessoas genuinamente gostam de falar com você. Você cria conexão em segundos.


Esforço gera recompensa | Você entende que, aqui, resultados = recompensas financeiras.


Treinável, não robótico | Você domina o processo e o script, e depois os torna seus.


Disseram que você não seria capaz | E você ainda está aqui. Pronto para provar que estavam errados.


Fala Inglês | Básico ao avançado — o suficiente para entender documentos e falar com nosso fundador.


O Que Você Fará

  • Fazer de 60 a 100 ligações por dia para leads qualificados.
  • Ter conversas reais sobre economia de energia.
  • Explicar nossa abordagem neutra e sem conflito de interesses.
  • Lidar com objeções. Superar o \"não tenho interesse\". Transformar \"talvez\" em \"sim\".
  • Fechar negócios. E depois fechar mais.
  • Este é um jogo de volume. Os melhores closers fazem o maior número de ligações. É matemática pura.


O Dinheiro (É Bom)


Métrica | O que significa


Base Fixa | R$ 6.000,00 mensais.  Estabilidade garantida enquanto você constrói.


Comissão por negócio | Generosa. Sem teto. Receba pelo seu desempenho.


OTE (Ganho Estimado) | Profissionais de alto desempenho superam R$ 12.000,00+  por mês.


Sem Limites | Não travamos sua comissão. Quanto mais você vende, mais você ganha.


O Pacote

  • Contrato PJ: Você trabalha como pessoa jurídica. Simples, direto e profissional.
  • Equipamento: Fornecemos laptop + toda a tecnologia necessária. Sem custo para você.
  • Ferramentas: Zoho, Portal, sistema de leads — tudo configurado e pronto.
  • Treinamento: Completo sobre o mercado de energia, nosso processo e ferramentas.
  • Suporte: Você nunca será deixado sozinho para \"dar um jeito\".


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós

  • Ganhos ilimitados: Sua renda é limitada apenas pelo seu esforço e habilidade.
  • Oportunidade massiva: Milhares de leads qualificados esperando para serem chamados.
  • Produto real: Nós realmente ajudamos donos de empresas a economizar dinheiro.
  • Sem microgerenciamento: Confiamos no seu trabalho duro. Seus resultados falam por si.
  • Potencial de crescimento: Quem performa vira líder de equipe, gerente e depois diretor.
  • Um lugar para os subestimados: Se já duvidaram de você antes, você vai se sentir em casa aqui.
  • Uso do Inglês: Sua habilidade no idioma é um trunfo real aqui.


Choque de Realidade

Este trabalho não é para todos. Você ouvirá \"não\" muito mais do que ouvirá \"sim\". Você fará ligações mesmo quando não estiver com vontade. Você passará por cima da rejeição e continuará em frente.

Mas, se você vencer, você vence grande.  Os melhores closers aqui ganharão mais do que muitos gerentes. Eles terão liberdade, respeito e um plano de carreira.


﻿

Como Se Candidatar

Não queremos currículos. Queremos ver você. Grave um vídeo de 30 segundos respondendo:

  • Quem é você? 2. Por que você? Pode ser em português. Apenas seja você mesmo. 30 segundos. Sem roteiro. Sem edições. Apenas você.
  • Envie para: ⚠️ IMPORTANTE: Candidaturas sem vídeo NÃO serão consideradas. Este trabalho é sobre falar com pessoas. Se você não consegue falar conosco por 30 segundos, não conseguirá falar com 100 clientes por dia. Vídeo ou nada.

Uma Última Coisa:  Não precisamos de especialistas em energia. Precisamos de pessoas disciplinadas, apaixonadas e que se importam com tudo o que fazem. O resto, nós ensinamos.

Ótima Energia  Construída por pessoas que não deveriam estar aqui.

description:

Commercial Executive

About the Opportunity

OYO is seeking a dynamic and results-driven individual to take on the role of Commercial Executive , focusing on driving business development and fostering strong relationships with our property partners. This position requires a strategic thinker with a passion for building and expanding our network of properties, maximizing revenue opportunities, and ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction.


This Commercial Executive role offers an exciting opportunity to drive business growth, expand OYO's presence in key markets, and contribute to the success of our organization. If you are a motivated and entrepreneurial individual with a passion for business development and hospitality, we invite you to join our team and help us build the most trusted brand in the world.

En OYO buscamos a una persona dinámica y orientada a resultados para ocupar el puesto de Ejecutivo Comercial, centrado en impulsar el desarrollo de negocio y fortalecer las relaciones con nuestros socios propietarios de propiedades. Esta posición requiere de un pensador estratégico con pasión por construir y expandir nuestra red de propiedades, maximizando las oportunidades de ingresos y asegurando una satisfacción excepcional del cliente.


El rol de Ejecutivo Comercial ofrece una oportunidad emocionante para impulsar el crecimiento empresarial, expandir la presencia de OYO en mercados clave y contribuir al éxito de nuestra organización. Si eres una persona motivada y emprendedora con pasión por el desarrollo de negocios y la hospitalidad, te invitamos a unirte a nuestro equipo y ayudarnos a construir la marca más confiable del mundo.

Brief Job Description

As a Commercial Executive , you will play a pivotal role in driving business growth by identifying and engaging with potential business partners to expand OYO's presence in key markets. You will be responsible for developing and executing strategies to attract new properties, negotiate agreements, and drive adoption of the OYO OS model. Additionally, you will work closely with property owners to understand their needs, provide ongoing support, and ensure a seamless onboarding process.

Como Ejecutivo Comercial, jugarás un papel crucial en el impulso del crecimiento empresarial identificando y comprometiéndote con socios comerciales potenciales para expandir la presencia de OYO en mercados clave. Serás responsable de desarrollar y ejecutar estrategias para atraer nuevas propiedades, negociar acuerdos e impulsar la adopción del modelo OYO OS. Además, trabajarás estrechamente con los propietarios de propiedades para comprender sus necesidades, proporcionar apoyo continuo y asegurar un proceso de integración fluido.

Job Overview

The Commercial Executive will be primarily focused on business development initiatives, including prospecting, lead generation, and partnership building. You will leverage your strong communication and negotiation skills to cultivate relationships with property owners, drive adoption of OYO's products and services, and maximize revenue opportunities. In addition to expanding our network of properties, you will also collaborate with internal teams to develop and implement strategies to optimize the performance of existing properties.

El Ejecutivo Comercial se centrará en el desarrollo de negocios, incluyendo la prospección, generación de leads y construcción de asociaciones. Utilizarás tus fuertes habilidades de comunicación y negociación para cultivar relaciones con los propietarios de propiedades, impulsar la adopción de los productos y servicios de OYO y maximizar las oportunidades de ingresos. Además de expandir nuestra red de propiedades, también colaborarás con equipos internos para desarrollar e implementar estrategias que optimicen el rendimiento de las propiedades existentes.

Responsibilities

  • Identify, pursue, and move leads through the sales cycle to expand OYO's network of properties in target markets.
  • Develop and execute strategic business development plans to achieve growth objectives.
  • Negotiate agreements with property owners to onboard new properties onto the OYO platform.
  • Meet with customers/clients face to face & or over the phone.
  • Developing proposals for clients.
  • Provide ongoing support to property owners, including assistance with onboarding, training, and troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to develop and implement strategies to optimize property performance and drive revenue growth.
  • Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify opportunities for expansion and differentiation.
  • Coordinate pricing strategies with Revenue Managers
  • Ensure room availability (for selling) for the company.
  • Recovery of debt.
  • Churn prevention: Engage with partners to educate them around the solutions Oyo provides and reduce churn.
  • Partner Experience: Ensuring our partners are looked after is critical and so this role is responsible in supporting post onboarding to ensure brand standards, recon statements, commercial understanding (if any) and act as a support function for the partner.
  • Identificar, perseguir y avanzar leads a través del ciclo de ventas para expandir la red de propiedades de OYO en mercados objetivo.
  • Desarrollar y ejecutar planes estratégicos de desarrollo de negocio para alcanzar objetivos de crecimiento.
  • Negociar acuerdos con propietarios de propiedades para integrar nuevas propiedades a la plataforma OYO.
  • Reunirse con clientes cara a cara o por teléfono.
  • Desarrollar propuestas para clientes.
  • Proporcionar apoyo continuo a los propietarios de propiedades, incluyendo asistencia con la integración, capacitación y solución de problemas.
  • Colaborar con equipos internos para desarrollar e implementar estrategias que optimicen el rendimiento de las propiedades y fomenten el crecimiento de ingresos.
  • Monitorear las tendencias del mercado y la actividad de los competidores para identificar oportunidades de expansión y diferenciación.
  • Coordinar estrategias de precios con los Gerentes de Ingresos.
  • Asegurar la disponibilidad de habitaciones (para venta) para la empresa.
  • Recuperación de deudas.
  • Prevención de deserción: Interactuar con socios para educarlos sobre las soluciones que OYO ofrece y reducir la deserción.
  • Experiencia del Socio: Asegurar el bienestar de nuestros socios es crítico y, por tanto, este rol es responsable de apoyar después de la integración para asegurar estándares de marca, entendimientos comerciales y actuar como función de apoyo para el socio.


Job Experience

2-3 years of relevant experience in business development, sales, or related fields, preferably in Real Estate and Hospitality industries.

2-3 años de experiencia relevante en desarrollo de negocios, ventas o campos relacionados, preferiblemente en las industrias de Bienes Raíces y Hospitalidad.


Education

Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Hospitality Management, or a related field.

Licenciatura en Administración de Empresas, Gestión Hotelera o campo relación


Language

Fluent in English (both verbal and written).

Inglés Fluido. Las entrevistas serán realizadas en Inglés.


Skills and qualifications

  • Drive and self-motivation.
  • Networking ability
  • Strong business development skills, with a proven track record of identifying and closing new business opportunities.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to analyze market trends, identify opportunities, and develop actionable plans to drive growth.
  • Results-oriented mindset with a focus on achieving targets and delivering measurable results.
  • Highly organized with strong project management skills and the ability to prioritize and multitask effectively.
  • Automotivación.
  • Capacidad de establecer redes de contacto.
  • Fuertes habilidades de desarrollo de negocio con un historial probado de identificación y cierre de nuevas oportunidades de negocio.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y negociación con la capacidad de construir y mantener relaciones con partes interesadas clave.
  • Pensador estratégico con la habilidad de analizar tendencias del mercado, identificar oportunidades y desarrollar planes de acción para impulsar el crecimiento.
  • Mentalidad orientada a resultados, con un enfoque en alcanzar objetivos y entregar resultados medibles.
  • Altamente organizado con fuertes habilidades de gestión de proyectos y la capacidad de priorizar y manejar múltiples tareas eficazmente.

title: Accountant (with Advanced English)
description:
About the Product


Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.


About the Role


The Associate Staff Accountant is a key operational member of the Finance team, responsible for owning day-to-day billing and accounts receivable activities while also serving as a backup and support resource across accounts payable, procurement, and general ledger operations.

This role sits at the intersection of accounting operations, customer communication, and financial systems. The Associate Staff Accountant ensures timely and accurate invoicing, collections, and customer support, while also contributing to month-end close, reconciliations, and process automation initiatives. You will work closely with the Associate Accounting Manager, Controller, and internal account managers to maintain accurate financial records and support scalable finance operations.


What You Will Do


Primary Responsibilities: Billing & Accounts Receivable

  • Customer Billing Ownership: Prepare, review, and issue accurate customer invoices in accordance with contracts, pricing schedules, and billing timelines.
  • Collections Management: Monitor accounts receivable aging, proactively follow up on overdue invoices, and manage customer communications to drive timely payment.
  • Cash Application: Apply customer payments accurately and promptly; research and resolve unapplied cash, short payments, and discrepancies.
  • Billing Disputes & Resolution: Partner with customers and internal account managers to investigate and resolve billing questions, disputes, and adjustments.
  • Customer Support: Serve as a primary finance contact for billing and payment inquiries, delivering clear, professional, and timely responses.


Reporting, Analysis & Cross-Functional Support

  • AR & Billing Reporting: Prepare AR aging reports, collections summaries, billing metrics, and customer-level analysis for Finance leadership.
  • Trend & Issue Identification: Identify recurring billing or collections issues and recommend process improvements.
  • Internal Collaboration: Support Customer Success and Account Management teams with invoice status, payment history, and customer financial insights.
  • Ad-Hoc Analysis: Assist with financial analysis and special projects related to revenue, AR, or operational accounting.


Secondary Responsibilities: AP, Procurement & GL (Backup Coverage)

  • Accounts Payable Support: Serve as backup for the full-cycle AP process, including invoice review, coding, approvals, and payment execution using tools such as Ramp.
  • Procurement & Spend Compliance: Ensure spend is appropriately authorized, documented, and coded to the correct GL accounts, departments, and locations.
  • Expense Management: Support travel and expense processing, including receipt matching and policy enforcement.
  • Vendor Relations (Backup): Assist with vendor inquiries and resolution of payment or billing issues as needed.


General Ledger & Month-End Close Support

  • Journal Entries: Prepare and post routine journal entries, accruals, and adjustments under supervision to support accurate financial reporting.
  • Reconciliations: Perform monthly reconciliations of bank and balance sheet accounts, investigating and resolving variances.
  • Audit & Documentation: Maintain organized support schedules and documentation for management review and external audits.
  • System Integrity: Monitor accounting system data flows to ensure automated postings align with accounting principles and internal controls.
  • Process Automation: Support ongoing efforts to improve efficiency and reduce manual work using modern accounting and fintech tools (e.g., Rillet, Ramp).


What We Are Looking For

  • Accounting Foundation: Solid understanding of basic accounting principles; familiarity with GAAP preferred.
  • AR & Billing Experience: Prior experience in billing, accounts receivable, collections, or customer-facing finance roles.
  • Customer Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal English skills with the ability to communicate professionally with external customers.
  • Technical Proficiency: Experience with modern accounting, billing, or expense management systems (e.g., Rillet, Ramp, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Zuora, Stripe, or similar).
  • Excel Skills: Proficient in Excel, including formulas, lookups, and pivot tables.
  • Detail-Oriented & Organized: High attention to accuracy, deadlines, and follow-through in a process-driven environment.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable supporting multiple accounting functions and serving as backup when priorities shift.
  • Experience Level: 4+ years of relevant accounting, billing, or AR experience; experience supporting US-based companies is a plus.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Analista de TI Sênior (Administrador de Redes)
description:
Somos o maior ressegurador do Brasil. Com mais de 80 anos de experiência, atuamos nas principais linhas de negócios em resseguros e contamos com uma equipe altamente qualificada, pronta para inovar e oferecer os melhores produtos e serviços ao mercado.


Estamos com 1 vaga de Analista de TI Sênior, com foco em Administração de Redes . Confira os detalhes abaixo:


FORMAÇÃO ACADÊMICA


  • Necessário Superior completo em Engenharia de Redes, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Certificações desejáveis: CCNA, CCNP, Fortinet NSE, CompTIA Network+, ITIL, Azure/AWS Network Engineer Associate.
  • Desejável pós-graduação em Infraestrutura de TI, Segurança da Informação ou Engenharia de Conectividade.


EXPERIÊNCIA/CONHECIMENTOS


  • Imprescindível experiência em administração e suporte de redes corporativas LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi, em ambientes on-premises e cloud;
  • Conhecimento avançado em roteamento, switching, firewalls, NAT, VLANs, QoS e VPNs;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de monitoramento e automação de rede (Zabbix, SolarWinds, PRTG, Ansible);
  • Experiência em ambientes híbridos e multicloud, com integração entre redes locais e provedores cloud;
  • Conhecimento de protocolos de rede (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, BGP, OSPF);
  • Familiaridade com segurança de rede, criptografia, IDS/IPS, segmentação e controle de acesso;
  • Capacidade de diagnóstico e troubleshooting de incidentes complexos de conectividade;
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos críticos e regulados, com requisitos de alta disponibilidade e compliance;
  • Familiaridade com soluções de rede e segurança Cisco, Palo Alto e Trend Micro;
  • Necessário Inglês técnico intermediário (para leitura de documentação e interface com fornecedores globais).



MISSÃO DA POSIÇÃO


Garantir a operação estável, segura e eficiente das redes de comunicação de dados e voz do IRB(Re), assegurando disponibilidade, desempenho e confiabilidade dos serviços de conectividade corporativa. É o responsável técnico pela infraestrutura de rede, abrangendo LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, firewalls e equipamentos de comunicação, suportando as operações do negócio e garantindo conformidade com as políticas de segurança e governança de TI.

Assegurar a continuidade e a resiliência das redes corporativas, promovendo padronização, automação e melhoria contínua da infraestrutura de conectividade que sustenta os sistemas críticos e o ambiente híbrido do IRB(Re).


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES


Gestão e Operação de Ambientes

  • Administrar e monitorar a rede corporativa LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi, em ambientes on-premises e cloud, garantindo disponibilidade, estabilidade e desempenho;
  • Configurar, manter e otimizar switches, roteadores, access points, firewalls, balanceadores e VPNs;
  • Monitorar a latência, throughput e integridade dos enlaces de rede, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas;
  • Executar rotinas de backup e restauração de configurações de rede;
  • Gerenciar e documentar o inventário de equipamentos de rede, seus contratos de manutenção;
  • Apoiar times de Service Desk e Infraestrutura na resolução de incidentes relacionados à conectividade;
  • Garantir o cumprimento de SLAs de disponibilidade e performance de rede, com reportes regulares à Governança de TI.


Implementação e Melhoria Contínua

  • Planejar e executar projetos de implantação, atualização e expansão de rede, em alinhamento com Engenharia & Plataforma;
  • Definição de escopo técnico para projetos de infraestrutura de redes, visando escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade dos serviços, garantindo o alinhamento entre requisitos técnicos e necessidades de negócio;
  • Avaliar novas tecnologias e padrões de conectividade (SD-WAN, Wi-Fi 6, 5G, Zero Trust Network Access);
  • Automatizar tarefas de configuração e monitoração com uso de ferramentas de gerenciamento de rede e scripts (Ansible, Python, SNMP, etc.);
  • Apoiar a integração de ambientes on-premises e cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP) garantindo conectividade segura;
  • Participar da definição de arquiteturas de rede resilientes e escaláveis, em conjunto com Arquitetura Corporativa;
  • Documentar diagramas, topologias e fluxos de rede no repositório corporativo de arquitetura;
  • Realizar testes de carga, failover e redundância em enlaces críticos.


Segurança, Governança e Compliance

  • Operar e gerenciar ferramentas de segurança, como: Endpoint Security, NGFW, PAM, WAF, Cloud Email Security, NAC, DNS Security, de acordo as diretrizes do CISO;
  • Monitorar e responder a alertas de segurança de rede, incidentes e vulnerabilidades, em colaboração com o time de Cyber Service;
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo evidências de controles e conformidade (LGPD, SUSEP, SOX);
  • Assegurar a execução de atualizações de firmware e patches de segurança nos dispositivos de rede;
  • Gerenciar logs e trilhas de auditoria de equipamentos e soluções de rede;
  • Apoiar o planejamento e execução de planos de continuidade e recuperação de desastres (DRP) para infraestrutura de rede.

  • Zelar pelos equipamentos de sua responsabilidade, efetuando limpeza após o uso, a fim de manter as regras de 5s, a fim de manter o ambiente saudável e seguro.

  • Treinar e orientar os almoxarifes da sua equipe.

CNH B;

Vivência com software de estoque.

title: Monitor (a) de Pesquisa Pleno - CRA II
description:
OBJETIVO DA POSIÇÃO


Gerenciar os centros de pesquisa de um determinado estudo e realizar monitoria dos centros de pesquisa do Brasil e/ou LATAM. Suporte aos monitores CRA I.


PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES:


  • Realizar visitas de monitoria on-site ou remotas (visitas de seleção, iniciação, periódicas e encerramento) de acordo com o escopo de trabalho contratado e os requisitos regulatórios, ou seja, as diretrizes de Boas Práticas Clínicas (GCP) e da Conferência Internacional de Harmonização (ICH).
  • Trabalhar com os centros para adaptar, impulsionar e rastrear o plano de recrutamento dos participantes de acordo com as necessidades do projeto para aumentar a previsibilidade.
  • Administrar protocolo e treinamento de estudo relacionado aos centros designados e estabelecer linhas regulares de comunicação com os centros para gerenciar expectativas e problemas contínuos do projeto.
  • Avaliar a qualidade e integridade das práticas do centro relacionadas à condução adequada do protocolo e adesão aos regulamentos aplicáveis. Escalar problemas de qualidade conforme apropriado.
  • Gerenciar o progresso dos estudos atribuídos rastreando submissões e aprovações regulatórias, recrutamento e elegibilidade, preenchimento da CRF e geração e resolução de queries.
  • Certificar-se de que cópias/originais (conforme necessário) dos documentos do centro estejam disponíveis para arquivamento no TMF e verificar se o ISF é mantido de acordo com GCP/ICH e requisitos regulatórios locais.
  • Criar e manter documentação apropriada relativa ao gerenciamento do centro, monitorar resultados de visitas e planos de ação, enviando relatórios de monitoria, gerando cartas de acompanhamento e outra documentação de estudo necessária.
  • Desenvolver materiais como plano de monitoria, apresentação de SIV, Newsletter e ferramentas para auxílio no processo de suas atividades, auxílio em processo contratual, apresentações em meeting de investigadores.
  • Colaborar e estabelecer ligação com os membros da equipe de estudo para apoio à execução do projeto, conforme apropriado.
  • Se aplicável, ser responsável pela gestão financeira do centro.
  • Atuar como mentor dos CRA I, incluindo a realização de visitas de co-monitoria e treinamento.


REQUISITOS DA POSIÇÃO:

- Formação Acadêmica

Graduação na Área da Saúde (Farmácia, Fisioterapia, Enfermagem, Biologia, Biomedicina, entre outras), pós-graduação na área preferencialmente, formação em pesquisa clínica


- Requisitos Técnicos:

Disponibilidade para viajar pelo menos 60% do tempo.


- Experiência:

Pelo menos 18 meses de experiência em pesquisa, experiência prévia em monitoria.


- Idiomas:

Inglês: Avançado.

Espanhol necessário para monitores LATAM.


- Soft Skills:

  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Adaptabilidade
  • Proatividade
  • Boa comunicação
  • Gerenciamento do tempo
  • Relacionamento interpessoal
  • Coerência

description:
Job Description

Job Title: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician

Location: Remote position in Brazil with in-person client visits as required

Contract Type: CLT


About LG Sonic: LG Sonic is a global leader in sustainable water quality management, dedicated to developing cutting-edge technologies that help protect water ecosystems. With operations in over 50 countries, we specialize in advanced solutions for algae control, water quality monitoring, and environmental protection. Our award-winning ultrasonic technology, combined with real-time data monitoring, empowers industries, municipalities, and governments to maintain clean and healthy water bodies while reducing chemical use. At LG Sonic, we foster a dynamic and innovative work environment, driven by a passion for sustainability and technological excellence. Join our team and be part of a mission to create cleaner water for future generations.


Position Summary:

The Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician will be responsible for assembling, installing, and maintaining LG Sonic equipment at our clients' sites across various locations in Brazil. In addition to on-site technical duties, the professional will work remotely in an after-sales capacity, providing direct support and maintaining close communication with clients to ensure their needs are met effectively.

Position duties and responsibilities:

  • Assemble and install LG Sonic equipment at client locations throughout Brazil, ensuring proper setup and functionality.
  • Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs on installed equipment to guarantee optimal performance.
  • Travel to client sites as needed to address technical issues and provide on-site support.
  • Provide remote after-sales support, responding to client inquiries, offering technical guidance, and resolving issues via phone, email, or other communication platforms.
  • Maintain direct and proactive communication with clients to ensure satisfaction and address their needs effectively.
  • Document all assembly, maintenance, and support activities, preparing detailed reports for internal records and client follow-ups.
  • Collaborate with the LG Sonic team to identify opportunities for equipment improvements or upgrades based on client feedback and field observations.
  • Adhere to safety protocols and company standards during all on-site and remote activities.


Qualification and requirements:

  • Must reside in Brazil and be willing to travel frequently to client sites across the country with flexibility to adapt to varying schedules.
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (written and spoken) for client interactions, technical support, and reporting.
  • Proven experience in equipment assembly, installation, and maintenance, preferably in a technical or industrial setting.
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently in the field and remotely, with strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Familiarity with remote support tools and basic computer skills for documentation and communication.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to operate safely in diverse working environments.
  • Previous experience in after-sales or customer support roles is a plus.


Why Join LG Sonic? At LG Sonic, we offer an exciting and collaborative work environment where your contributions directly impact our mission of environmental sustainability and innovation. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to grow professionally while being a part of a global leader in water treatment technology. We believe in investing in our people and fostering an inclusive culture where every team member’s ideas are valued.


LG Sonic Values : Unity, Trust, Positivism, Over deliver and Passion.

title: Direct Response Video Editor
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Build the creative engine behind performance.

Portent Brands is a holding company scaling a portfolio of healthcare and ecommerce brands through performance creative and paid growth. We build brands that win at the unit economics level—and great creative is central to how we do it.


As our DTC Video Editor, you’ll own the full lifecycle of paid video creative across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and Google. You’ll work directly with our Creative Lead and Head of Growth—taking briefs from concept to final ad independently, then iterating fast based on what the data says.


This isn’t a brand-only role. Performance, output velocity, and creative precision are the metrics that matter here. You’ll use AI tools to compress production timelines, leverage motion design to elevate hooks, and bring a direct-response instinct to every cut.


Over time, you’ll become a core creative engine across Growth, CRO, and Product—shaping how our brands convert at scale.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

Own the output. Drive the numbers.

  • DTC Video Editing: Edit and ship conversion-focused video ads for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and Google. Every cut has a performance objective.
  • Motion Design: Build sharp animations and motion graphics that reinforce hooks, brand identity, and storytelling clarity.
  • Creative Variations: Produce fast, high-quality iterations across hooks, angles, formats, pacing, and lengths to fuel continuous testing.
  • AI-Powered Production: Actively use AI video, voice, image, and asset generation tools to move from concept to finished ad in hours—not days.
  • Data-Driven Editing: Review performance metrics (thumb-stop rate, hold rate, CTR, ROAS) and translate insights directly into creative decisions.
  • A/B Testing: Run structured creative experiments and iterate quickly based on results.
  • Optimization: Continuously sharpen pacing, copy overlays, hooks, captions, structure, sound design, and visual clarity.
  • Trend Awareness: Stay current on paid social trends, platform best practices, and emerging editing and AI tools.


WHAT YOU BRING

Skills that ship.

  • Experience: 3+ years editing high-performing DTC paid social ads. Strong portfolio of Meta and TikTok creatives required.
  • Editing Tools: Expert in Adobe Premiere Pro, Capcut, Davinci Resolve. Solid working knowledge of After Effects and Photoshop.
  • Motion Design: Strong command of animation, typography, transitions, sound design, pacing, color, and visual storytelling.
  • Performance Mindset: You understand what makes a direct-response ad work—hooks, clarity, messaging hierarchy, pacing, and CTA structure.
  • AI Fluency: Comfortable using AI tools daily as part of your production stack, not as a novelty.
  • Output Velocity: Able to manage multiple edits simultaneously, hit deadlines, and sustain high-quality output at scale.
  • Captions & Copy: Writes and applies accurate, compelling English captions that reinforce messaging and hooks.
  • Execution: Takes a brief to final cut independently. Moves fast without losing craft.
  • Ownership: Finds what’s missing, fixes it, and keeps work moving without being asked.
  • Collaboration: Works fluidly with the team. Takes direct feedback and turns it around fast.
  • AI Video Tools: Hands-on experience with AI-native video editing or automation tools.
  • Creative Strategy: Familiarity with direct-response creative frameworks, hook testing, and angle development.
  • Industry: Experience with DTC, healthcare, wellness, or weight-loss brands.
  • High-Volume Teams: Background in high-throughput creative environments where output volume is tied directly to performance.


NICE TO HAVE

Bonus points.

  • Industry: Experience with DTC, healthcare, wellness, or weight-loss brands.


Compensation:

  • Base salary of $1,250 per month.
  • Performance incentive based on creative performance
  • OTE $5,000 per month

title: Brand & Copy Strategist
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a Brand & Copy Strategist!


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


Purpose of This Position


As a Brand & Copy Strategist, you are responsible for writing and owning all copy for the clients within your squad, ensuring that every word reflects the brand’s voice, positioning, and intent.

You ensure that every piece of written content across websites, social media, email, and campaigns is on-brand, intentional, and delivered at a high standard. You bring together copywriting, brand awareness, practical content direction, strategy, and project management to ensure brands are represented clearly and consistently through words.


You act as the bridge between brand intent and execution, translating client goals and direction into clear, purposeful copy that is ready for internal review and client delivery.


Core Responsibility


Serve as the owner of brand representation through copy for your squad’s clients. Your accountability is defined by the following questions:

  • “Is this copy clear, on-brand, purposeful, and strong enough to confidently move forward?”
  • \"Is this project timeline possible with the resources we have for proper execution?”


Main Objectives


1. Content Execution & Copywriting

  • Write high-quality, purpose-driven copy for:
  • -Websites
  • -Social media captions and post copy
  • -Email campaigns
  • -Campaign and promotional assets
  • Design-related copy (headlines, CTAs, supporting text)
  • Act as the primary writer for all copy deliverables within your squad.
  • Ensure every piece of copy is written with intention, clarity, and audience awareness.
  • Perform copyediting on your own work to maintain consistency, grammatical excellence, and brand alignment, using tools and peers as needed.


2. Strategy & Project Management

  • Create social media strategies for your clients based on their goals and audiences
  • Keep track of client feedback and apply them to future work
  • Plan content in batches for the month, ensuring:
  • -Consistency in writing style
  • -Variety in content types
  • -A range of related, engaging topics


3. Social Media Copy & Content Direction

  • Develop and write social media copy that reflects the brand’s voice and messaging.
  • When appropriate, define content themes and messaging direction for social platforms.
  • When deeper strategy or clarity is required, collaborate with Special Teams to receive social content strategy support or plans.
  • Execute all social media copy in alignment with the strategy you create and flag any gaps or unclear direction early.


4. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency

  • Participate in brainstorming and ideation sessions to help define the content, messaging, and assets required for campaigns and initiatives.
  • Provide copy-led input on creative direction to ensure consistency of brand voice, messaging, and intent across all touchpoints.
  • Collaborate with designers, Marketing Coordinators, and Account Managers to align written and visual assets under a cohesive brand narrative.
  • Contribute perspective beyond copy when needed to maintain brand clarity and consistency.


5. Brand Advocacy

  • Act as the copy owner for each assigned brand, ensuring consistent voice, tone, and messaging across all written content.
  • Apply brand guidelines and positioning directly within copy execution.
  • Review copy deliverables to ensure they meet internal quality standards and accurately represent the brand’s intent.


Reporting Relationship

  • This role reports to the designated Account Manager of your squad.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


1. Brand Alignment & Copy Effectiveness

  • Ensure all copy deliverables are consistently aligned with the brand’s voice, tone, and messaging.
  • Maintain minimal client revisions related to brand alignment, tone, or clarity.
  • Contribute social content ideas and messaging angles when needed, ensuring alignment with the brand’s voice, positioning, and goals.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure brand consistency across copy and supporting assets.


2. Content Quality & Accuracy

  • Deliver copy that meets internal quality standards for clarity, structure, and purpose.
  • Maintain a low rate of client dissatisfaction related to copy quality or intent.


3. Project Delivery Timeliness

  • Deliver copy-related tasks within agreed timelines.
  • Collaborate with the squad to support smooth handoffs and on-time delivery of content assets.


Work Details

  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Video Lead
description:
Impact3 - Video Lead

Join Impact3 – Help Us Change the Game in Crypto

Location: 100% Remote


How to Apply

  • Please submit a 2–3 minute Loom video highlighting your experience with video editing, including the tools you use, how you leverage AI, and your overall creative process. Be sure to attach your portfolio as well.


About Impact3

Impact3 is a growth marketing agency of crypto-native marketers dedicated to building trusted brands in the trustless technology space - aka crypto.

We specialize in social media management, public relations, paid advertising, visual production, strategy, go-to-market campaigns and more.


The Role

We don’t want just a \"Video Editor.\" We want a Video Architect. You should be someone who looks at a manual 20-hour editing task and finds a way to do it in 4 hours at a higher quality using your custom AI tech stack.

As the Video Lead at Impact3, you are the architect of our visual narrative. You don’t just \"edit video\", you build the engine that produces high-end, viral-ready content at the speed of the internet. You will lead a team of creators to transform complex crypto concepts into hyper-realistic, professional video assets.

This is a leadership role, but it is also hands-on. You must be comfortable leading a team while actively working inside Premiere Pro and After Effects yourself.

Your mission is to bridge the gap between \"standard social video\" and \"cinematic AI production,\" ensuring Impact3 remains the most innovative agency in the Web3 space.


  • Hyper-Realistic Storyboarding: Lead the pre-production process by using AI to generate high-fidelity, professional-grade storyboards that look like final frames. You will set the visual \"North Star\" for every project before a single second of video is rendered.
  • Production Leadership (Hands-On): Manage and mentor a team of video editors, ensuring all outputs meet \"Senior\" quality standards while maintaining an AI-first workflow. You must be capable of stepping in, solving technical challenges directly, and setting the creative and technical bar through execution.
  • End-to-End AI Integration: Own the process of incorporating generative AI (Video-to-Video, Text-to-Video, AI Voiceover, and Generative Audio) into the traditional post-production pipeline.
  • Process Architecture: Document and refine the \"Impact3 Video Playbook\"—creating scalable workflows that allow the team to pivot from TikTok/Reels to high-end brand films instantly.
  • Quality Control: Act as the final gatekeeper for visual polish, advanced motion graphics, color grading, and \"the vibe,\" ensuring everything is culturally relevant to the crypto audience.


Key Skills and Qualifications

  • Proficient English Level: You must be able to communicate complex creative visions and lead meetings in English fluently. This is non-negotiable.
  • Vast AI Knowledge: You must demonstrate a documented history of using AI tools (e.g., Runway, Pika, Sora, Kling, Midjourney, ElevenLabs) to solve production bottlenecks and elevate visual quality.
  • Capacity to Lead: You have experience managing creative teams, giving actionable feedback, setting standards, and taking ownership of deadlines.
  • Storyboarding Mastery: Ability to create professional, hyper-realistic boards that accurately represent lighting, composition, and movement.
  • Adobe Proficiency (Premiere + After Effects): You must be highly proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro and advanced in After Effects. After Effects proficiency is mandatory for professional-grade motion graphics, compositing, and AI-integrated post-production workflows.
  • Hands-On Technical Strength: You are not just a manager—you are capable of executing complex edits, building motion systems, and solving production challenges directly.
  • (Nice to have) Crypto-Native Fluency: Understanding \"Crypto Twitter\" culture, memes, and the visual language of Web3 is a major plus but not a dealbreaker if you are a fast learner.


How Our Team Works (Our Ethos)

  • We’re in this together: no silos, no egos; we support each other.
  • Take ownership: be accountable, act like an owner, go the extra mile.
  • Get shit done: move fast, focus on execution, learn by doing.
  • Simplify & systemize: build processes, document workflows, work smarter.
  • Lead by example: learn first, then teach and raise the bar.
  • Speak up: over-communicate, ask for help, share ideas openly.
  • Get obsessed: live the space, bring curiosity, chase excellence.


What We Offer:

  • A dynamic and challenging role in a rapidly evolving industry.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and leadership development.
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Remote work: our team spans Canada, USA, Mexico, Spain, Italy, Bulgaria, Albania, Macedonia, Romania, India, Portugal, Brazil, Argentina and more.
  • Annual retreat to build relationships and plan for growth.
  • Competitive compensation based on skills and experience.

title: Desenvolvedor BackEnd Sênior - JavaScript/Node + AWS
description:
Sobre a InBot:

Somos uma empresa especializada em Inteligência Artificial Conversacional. Desenvolvemos assistentes virtuais inteligentes que integram PLN (Processamento de Linguagem Natural), busca semântica e IA generativa, oferecendo experiências únicas para usuários e resultados práticos para nossos clientes.


Na InBot, você vai trabalhar com projetos que envolvem desde personagens digitais (como Mia, Ricardo, Fernando) até soluções robustas para grandes empresas e governos, usando tecnologia de ponta para transformar a comunicação entre pessoas e organizações.


Mais sobre nós:


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Arquitetura e Refinamento Técnico (Discovery → Delivery): Atuar junto às áreas de negócio e ao time técnico no levantamento, análise e refinamento de requisitos, traduzindo necessidades em especificações técnicas claras (user stories, critérios de aceite, regras de negócio, fluxos e integrações) e apoiando a definição da melhor arquitetura para entrega.


Gestão Técnica do Backlog: Apoiar a organização e priorização técnica das demandas, garantindo que as atividades estejam bem detalhadas, quebradas em entregas incrementais e com dependências mapeadas, reduzindo retrabalho e aumentando previsibilidade.


Definição de Solução e Padrões: Propor e documentar padrões técnicos, decisões de arquitetura (ADRs), contratos de API e boas práticas (observabilidade, versionamento, consistência de integrações, idempotência, retries, rate limit, etc.), garantindo escalabilidade e manutenibilidade.


Colaboração e Alinhamento Contínuo: Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis (refinamento, planning, review), contribuindo para clareza técnica, estimativas realistas e alinhamento entre produto, operações e desenvolvimento.


Qualidade e Segurança no Ciclo de Desenvolvimento: Reforçar práticas de code review, testes automatizados, análise estática e segurança (OWASP, gestão de segredos, IAM least privilege), garantindo qualidade do código e confiabilidade das entregas.


Uso de IA Generativa com Governança: Utilizar IA generativa para potencializar produtividade (análise de logs, geração/validação de testes, rascunho de documentação, scaffolding de código e refatorações assistidas), mantendo rigor em revisão humana, versionamento, padrões internos e práticas de segurança.


Mentoria e Multiplicação Técnica: Apoiar o desenvolvimento do time, com mentorias, revisão de PRs, suporte em decisões de design e disseminação de boas práticas para elevar o nível técnico do squad.


Desenvolvimento em Nuvem: Atuar em ambientes AWS (EC2, EKS, ECR, ACM, RDS), garantindo performance, escalabilidade e segurança.

Conteinerização e Orquestração: Implementar e gerenciar containers com Docker e Kubernetes (administração, criação de pods, serviços, ingress, etc.).

Integrações de Sistemas: Desenvolver integrações entre o assistente virtual e os sistemas dos clientes utilizando APIs REST e JSON, além de OpenAPI/Swagger.

Desenvolvimento Backend: Trabalhar principalmente com JavaScript, Node.js, Promises, HTML5, CSS e TypeScript para criar funcionalidades robustas e assíncronas de forma eficiente.

Autenticação e Segurança: Implementar autenticação com OIDC (OpenID Connect), SAML e aplicar práticas de desenvolvimento seguro.

Criação e Manutenção de APIs: Desenvolver APIs internas e externas com documentação clara e padronizada.

Gestão de Bancos de Dados: Criar, administrar e otimizar bancos relacionais e não relacionais (SQL, MongoDB, RDS na AWS).

Ambiente Linux: Gerenciar e configurar servidores Linux, utilizando Shell Script para automação.

Controle de Versões: Utilizar Git para versionamento de código, integração contínua e práticas de CI/CD.

Desenvolvimento de Relatórios: Criar queries e relatórios para produtos e serviços.

Boas Práticas: Aplicar Promises, testes automatizados, documentação de código e metodologias ágeis para garantir escalabilidade e qualidade.


Diferenciais:

Experiência com arquitetura orientada a eventos (filas, mensageria, processamento assíncrono) e padrões de resiliência.

Familiaridade com IA aplicada ao ciclo de desenvolvimento (ex.: geração de testes, revisão assistida, documentação automatizada) com governança e segurança.

Conhecimento em microserviços e arquitetura serverless.

Experiência com DevOps e ferramentas de CI/CD.

Familiaridade com IA Generativa para otimização de processos e experiência do usuário.

Conhecimento em arquitetura de sistemas (redes, firewalls, DNS, roteamento, modelagem de dados).

Experiência com Java ou Scala.

Desenvolvimento Full Stack: Atuar também em camadas de front-end sempre que necessário, garantindo a integração de ponta a ponta.


Requisitos e qualificações

Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência: Mínimo 5 anos comprovados em desenvolvimento, essencialmente com JavaScript e Node.js.

Conhecimentos Técnicos Imprescindíveis:

AWS (EC2, EKS/Kubernetes, ECR, ACM, RDS)

APIs REST e JSON

Git (controle de código e versionamento)

Linux (administração e Shell)

Promises e programação assíncrona em JavaScript

Práticas de desenvolvimento seguro e testes automatizados


Soft Skills e Competências Comportamentais:

Tradução Negócio ↔ Técnica: Capacidade de entender rapidamente o contexto do cliente e transformar necessidades em soluções técnicas claras, alinhadas com prazos, riscos e impactos.


Senso de Dono e Pragmatismo: Foco em entregar valor com qualidade, escolhendo soluções sustentáveis e evitando complexidade desnecessária.


Organização e Comunicação Técnica: Saber conduzir refinamentos, registrar decisões e manter o time alinhado, garantindo transparência e clareza sobre escopo, riscos e dependências.


Trabalho em Equipe: Colaborar com times multidisciplinares, garantindo alinhamento técnico e de negócio.

Organização e Gestão de Prioridades: Capacidade de lidar com múltiplos projetos simultaneamente e cumprir prazos.

Comunicação: Clareza e objetividade ao se comunicar com clientes e equipe interna.

Senso de Lógica e Criatividade: Resolver problemas de forma analítica, criando soluções robustas e escaláveis.


Informações adicionais

Contrato PJ + cartão Flash.

Regime híbrido: presencial até 3x por semana no escritório (próximo à Av. Paulista).

Projetos desafiadores e inovadores, com tecnologia de ponta em IA conversacional.

  • Ambiente colaborativo, que valoriza autonomia, criatividade e foco em resultado.

title: SAP Basis Consultant
description:
Analista PL / Consultor SAP Basis



Responsabilidades:


1. Fornecer suporte técnico avançado, aderindo aos padrões de qualidade e requisitos regulamentares, garantindo a conformidade com as políticas da empresa nos ambientes SAP Basis e SAP HANA DB.

2. Resolver incidentes complexos escalados por analistas, realizando análises de causa raiz completas e implementando soluções eficazes para resolver problemas técnicos e de segurança.

3. Facilitar a transferência de conhecimento, atualizando e gerenciando a base de conhecimento, treinando novos membros da equipe e orientando analistas para aprimorar as capacidades da equipe.

4. Gerenciar e resolver chamados complexos dentro dos SLAs acordados, colaborando com equipes de suporte multifuncionais para manter a eficiência operacional e garantir uma postura de segurança robusta.

5. Aprimorar a experiência do cliente, alcançando altas taxas de resolução no primeiro contato, minimizando resoluções rejeitadas e reaberturas de casos, enquanto mitiga proativamente as ameaças à segurança.


Requisitos:

  • Inglês avançado. - boa comunicação, participação em chamadas, etc. (OBRIGATÓRIO)
  • Sólido conhecimento do pacote de soluções SAP e arquitetura técnica, com capacidade de traduzir desafios de negócios.
  • 4. Fortes habilidades de consultoria e gestão de stakeholders – habilidades demonstráveis de apresentação, consultoria voltada para o cliente e influência até o nível executivo (C-suite). Todos os candidatos devem ser assertivos e articulados, com capacidade de desenvolver e manter relacionamentos com clientes de alto nível.
  • 5. Compreensão da estratégia de produto da SAP, incluindo o posicionamento do S/4HANA e ferramentas de habilitação e tecnologias complementares, especialmente a integração com outros aplicativos.
  • 6. Bom conhecimento das ofertas de nuvem pública GCP, AWS e Azure e arquitetura de soluções.

title: Consultor Sênior Copilot
description:
A Atos é uma empresa líder mundial em transformação digital, oferecendo serviços de transação de alta tecnologia, consultoria, integração de sistemas, cloud e serviços gerenciados. Além disso, anunciada como parceira mundial de TI nos Jogos Olímpicos e Paraolímpicos!


Presente em mais de 70 países e com aproximadamente 100.000 especialistas ao redor do mundo, nossa empresa está no novo ranking Digital 100 da Forbes, uma lista das principais empresas de capital aberto que moldam o mundo digital nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação (TI), hardware, mídia, e-commerce e telecomunicações.


Estamos buscando um Consultor Sênior Copilot para atuação em cliente Atos!


Atuação hibrida no Jabaquara.


Título: Consultor Sênior Copilot

Profissional sênior para articular estratégia e adoção de soluções Copilot (ex.: Microsoft 365/GitHub Copilot) junto às áreas de negócio. Identifica oportunidades, lidera PoCs e pilotos, traduz resultados em benefícios tangíveis e orienta times e stakeholders na implementação e governança de assistentes baseados em LLMs.



Principais atividades:

  • Conduzir mapeamento estratégico de processos e identificar casos de uso de alto impacto para Copilot.
  • Levantar requisitos com stakeholders de níveis executivo e operacional; alinhar valor de negócio e roadmap de implementação.
  • Projetar e liderar PoCs, pilotos e demonstrações executivas, traduzindo resultados técnicos em métricas de negócio (produtividade, custo, risco).
  • Definir arquitetura de soluções, integrações e padrões de prompt engineering; validar soluções com equipes de TI e segurança.
  • Medir adoção, eficácia e ROI; propor melhorias e escalonamento com base em dados.
  • Orientar e capacitar times internos e clientes por meio de treinamentos, playbooks e suporte contínuo.
  • Atuar como ponto focal para governança, privacidade, conformidade e gestão de riscos associada a LLMs e Copilot.
  • Mentorar profissionais juniores/analistas e colaborar com líderes para promover cultura de uso responsável e escalável.


Requisitos:

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em projetos de IA/LLMs, automação ou transformação digital com interação direta com áreas de negócio.
  • Conhecimento prático de Copilot (Microsoft 365/GitHub) e conceitos de prompt engineering, APIs e integrações.
  • Familiaridade com ambientes cloud (preferência Azure), segurança de dados e requisitos de conformidade.
  • Forte capacidade de comunicação, facilitação e apresentação executiva; habilidade para traduzir tecnologia em resultados de negócio.
  • Experiência em liderar PoCs/pilotos e mensurar impacto (KPIs/ROI).


Diferenciais:

  • Certificações Microsoft (ex.: Copilot, Azure) ou Power Platform.
  • Vivência em adoção em larga escala de assistentes conversacionais/LLMs e experiência com change management.
  • Experiência prévia em consultoria estratégica ou gestão de programas.
