title: Médico Endocrinologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA, concluída ou em andamento.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia, comprovante de matrícula em Residência, Pós Graduação, Especialização em Endocrinologia.
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

title: Product Designer
description:
SigmaMD aims to make a meaningful contribution to the world by changing the way people manage their health. Our growing engineering and product team has deep expertise in consumer tech. We are combining our diverse backgrounds to innovate in Digital Health.


Our goal is to make millions of lives healthier by using technology. We strive to empower patients to take control of their health care and help clinicians better treat them. To achieve this vision we need an outstanding and passionate Product Designer to take on the following responsibilities:


  • Contribute to high-level product thinking while also developing interaction flows, mockups, and prototypes. 
  • Collaborate in a cross-functional team to understand user needs and business goals, and translate them into intuitive and effective product designs.
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and mockups to communicate design concepts and gather feedback.
  • Advocate for the needs and preferences of both doctors and patients by conducting user research and gathering feedback from both groups, and incorporating their insights into the design process to ensure the product meets the needs of all stakeholders.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends, design best practices, and the latest design tools and technologies to ensure the team is delivering high-quality, cutting-edge products.


This person should share our core values of teamwork, empathy, and innovation. Ideally, they have the following:


  • Know how to define a repeatable and shareable design process that encourages collaboration between design, product, and engineering teams.
  • Ask questions that build or help to clarify the problem statement and ensure that you maintain user focus and empathy.
  • Explore and refine concepts, then narrow to the best solution, weighing technical feasibility and scope with your team.
  • Create and maintain UX and UI deliverables including information architecture, wireframes, prototypes, style guides, micro interaction specifications, and pattern libraries.
  • Influence the product vision leading and participating in research, focused on both the intangibles (emotional needs) and tangibles (functional needs)..
  • Champion usability testing within your product team, capture the team's assumptions, identify the correct test methodology to use, document results, communicate actionable feedback and findings back to the team.
  • Communicate your design rationale to project stakeholders and use data to defend your design choices.


Required Skills

  • 2+ years of product design experience (including equivalent UI and UX focused role).
  • Able to provide samples of work that show creative solutions to complex products, strong visual design, and information architecture.
  • A strong understanding of the entire product development process, from research and problem solving through to detailed UI and visual design.
  • Experience with Figma.
  • Understand how modern technologies are used with design.
  • Believe that product and design decisions are inextricably linked.
  • Enjoy shipping small, quick experiments to explore and validate your ideas.
  • Know how to balance the user experience with technical and business requirements.
  • Able to communicate effectively with all stakeholders. Speak KPIs, OKRs and understand how to rely on data to support your work.
  • Not afraid to learn new things to take on a problem.
  • Are a self-starter who works proactively to solve problems and bring clarity to ambiguity
  • Facilitate both design-focused and cross-functional sessions with ease, relying on your knowledge of facilitation tools and techniques


Desired Skills

  • Have an understanding of front end technologies such as HTML and CSS.
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence.
  • Prior experience in a design related role at a startup.
  • Experience with digital health or relatable areas.
  • Experience working with mobile apps.

title: DevOps Engineer SR
description:
DevOps Engineer SR


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Design, deploy, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS CloudFormation;
  • Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI or similar tools, including automated deployments, rollback strategies, and environment versioning;
  • Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across databases, services, network layers, and workloads;
  • Lead AWS cost‑optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description


EMP is a media and technology company building audience-driven brands across digital media, content, and now SaaS products.

We started as a digital media group with a fan-first mindset and have grown into a company that blends content, distribution, and technology. Today, we are expanding beyond media into software products that support creators, brands, and audiences. That means design work here goes beyond social graphics and videos. It increasingly touches product thinking, UX/UI, and how software is presented to users.

We move fast, test often, and care about clean execution. Collaboration matters, but so does ownership. If you like building things that ship and actually get used, you will fit in well here.


You Are


An experienced graphic designer who can execute high-quality visual work across media and digital products. You are comfortable working in fast-moving environments, collaborating with editors, marketers, and product-minded teammates. You care about clarity, usability, and aesthetics, not just making things look cool.

You are also curious about software and product design, and you are interested in expanding your skill set into UX/UI and SaaS-oriented design work.


Role Description

This is a full-time, remote role for a Graphic Designer.

You will create visual assets across our media brands, including graphics, branding elements, and design systems for social, web, and video. You will also support our growing SaaS initiatives by contributing to UX/UI design, product mockups, and software framing using tools like Figma.

Your work will sit at the intersection of content, marketing, and product. You will help translate ideas into clean visuals, clear user flows, and consistent brand experiences across platforms.

Day-to-day responsibilities include concepting, designing, iterating based on feedback, and collaborating with media, marketing, and product stakeholders.


Responsibilities


  • Design graphics, branding assets, and visual systems for digital media platforms
  • Support video and social content with strong visual design
  • Contribute to UX/UI design for SaaS and internal software products
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and product flows using Figma
  • Maintain brand consistency across media, web, and product surfaces
  • Collaborate with marketing, content, and product teams
  • Iterate quickly and incorporate feedback without friction


Qualifications


  • Strong foundation in graphic design and visual communication
  • Experience with branding, logo design, and typography
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Working knowledge of Figma and interest in UX/UI or product design
  • Attention to detail and strong design judgment
  • Clear communication skills and ability to work independently in a remote setup
  • Experience in digital media, marketing, or tech is a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or equivalent experience
  • Fluent in English, written and spoken

title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
  • Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
  • Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
  • Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data

  • Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.g., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions.
  • Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience.
  • Python proficiency required; proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss.
  • Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent).
  • RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design.
  • Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems.
  • Comfort with SQL and structured data workflows


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

title: Full Stack Engineer, Brazil
description:
About Optibus:

Optibus is a unified software platform revolutionizing public transportation planning, scheduling, and operations in over 7,000 cities worldwide. Using AI, ML, and optimization algorithms, it empowers agencies to design more efficient, equitable, and sustainable transit networks, enhancing passenger access, reducing emissions, and improving driver conditions. With offices globally and a team of 350+ employees, Optibus fosters a collaborative culture centered on innovation, determination, and impact. As the first unicorn in public transportation technology, Optibus is driving the modernization of mass transit to make it the preferred choice for cities and passengers alike.


About the position (role & team):

Optibus is looking for a talented Full Stack Engineer to join our Planning R&D team in the mission of making transportation smarter and more efficient. We're seeking a mid-level engineer with a strong software development background and experience building and maintaining modern web applications.

As a Full Stack Engineer on the Planning Team, you’ll contribute to the development of features and improvements for our mass transportation planning products, collaborating with other engineers, product managers, and designers to create high-quality, user-focused solutions.


Responsibilities :

  • Develop, deploy, and maintain full-stack applications using React, TypeScript in the frontend, and Node.js with TypeScript deployed on K8S in the backend
  • Actively participate in the entire development lifecycle, engaging in technical discussions
  • Collaborate with the Product Manager and Designer to deliver robust, scalable features.


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of full-stack web development
  • Experience with React client-side development
  • Experience with Node.js server-side development
  • Understanding of web application architecture
  • Familiarity with relational or NoSQL DBs (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  • B.Sc. or M.Sc. in computer science or a related field
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills


It would be great if you have:

  • Experience with Python
  • Experience with AWS or an alternative cloud environment
  • Experience in the mobility ecosystem
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and CI/CD processes


Optibus is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, cultural background, religious beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. It is our responsibility at Optibus to provide an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all. We will provide reasonable accommodations for all candidates in need of individualised support during the hiring process.

▪ Integrar o APM com outros módulos do ServiceNow, incluindo ITSM e SAM.

▪ Utilizar fortes competências técnicas e expertise para identificar, analisar e solucionar problemas em produção, mantendo procedimentos que atendam às expectativas dos usuários de negócio.

▪ Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes multifuncionais e times de desenvolvimento para entender e fornecer soluções/correções automatizadas.

▪ Participar de eventos SCRUM e concluir os itens atribuídos dentro da meta definida para a Sprint.

Qualificações essenciais

• Graduação ou Mestrado em Computação, Eletrônica ou área relacionada

• Certificação ServiceNow System Administrator (CSA)

• Certificação ServiceNow Certified Application Portfolio Management (APM) Implementer

• Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de comunicar informações técnicas para públicos não técnicos


Competências-chave

▪ 8 a 10 anos de experiência total na área de TI

▪ Conhecimento intermediário em linguagens de desenvolvimento: XML, HTML, CSS, Java e JavaScript

▪ Experiência na plataforma ServiceNow como Administrador e Desenvolvedor

▪ Experiência no desenvolvimento de Service Catalogs, implementação de ACLs, transform maps, Flows via Flow Designer, client scripts e métricas de saúde da CMDB

▪ Mais de 5 anos de experiência em administração ServiceNow nas seguintes áreas: Service Catalog, CMDB & Discovery, Service Portal, Workflows, Dashboards, REST APIs

▪ Experiência prévia com o módulo APM é desejável


Outras habilidades e competências

▪ Capacidade de adaptação rápida para aprender novas ferramentas, novas tecnologias e padrões atuais do mercado

▪ Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente global e distribuído, sem supervisão

▪ Perfil autodirigido, proativo e com pensamento sistêmico

title: Brazil - Remote: Data Engineer - Platform & Pipelines
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from \"Bronze\" (Raw) to \"Silver\" (Cleaned) and \"Gold\" (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

What You’ll Do

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time; make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
  • Data Processing: Polars (primary for ETL), PySpark/SQL (for massive scale)
  • Compute : Single-node workers (Polars), Databricks/Spark clustrers (when scale requires)
  • Storage: Delta Lake, Parquet, S3/Blob Storage, MinIO
  • Language: Python 3.12+ (w/ Polars), SQL.


Qualifications


Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in Apache Airflow and Databricks .
  • Experience implementing Medallion/Delta Lake architectures.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills.
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Experience with Unity Catalog or other governance tools.
  • Familiarity with dbt (data build tool).
  • Background in processing telemetry or sensor data.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • The Structured Thinker: You love organizing data. You understand the importance of schemas, data typing, and normalization.
  • Quality Obsessive: You don't just move data; you test it. You implement checks to ensure no bad data reaches the Gold layer.
  • Pipeline Builder: You view data engineering as software engineering. You write modular, reusable code for your transformations.

About the Opportunity

OYO is seeking a dynamic and results-driven individual to take on the role of Commercial Executive , focusing on driving business development and fostering strong relationships with our property partners. This position requires a strategic thinker with a passion for building and expanding our network of properties, maximizing revenue opportunities, and ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction.


This Commercial Executive role offers an exciting opportunity to drive business growth, expand OYO's presence in key markets, and contribute to the success of our organization. If you are a motivated and entrepreneurial individual with a passion for business development and hospitality, we invite you to join our team and help us build the most trusted brand in the world.

En OYO buscamos a una persona dinámica y orientada a resultados para ocupar el puesto de Ejecutivo Comercial, centrado en impulsar el desarrollo de negocio y fortalecer las relaciones con nuestros socios propietarios de propiedades. Esta posición requiere de un pensador estratégico con pasión por construir y expandir nuestra red de propiedades, maximizando las oportunidades de ingresos y asegurando una satisfacción excepcional del cliente.


El rol de Ejecutivo Comercial ofrece una oportunidad emocionante para impulsar el crecimiento empresarial, expandir la presencia de OYO en mercados clave y contribuir al éxito de nuestra organización. Si eres una persona motivada y emprendedora con pasión por el desarrollo de negocios y la hospitalidad, te invitamos a unirte a nuestro equipo y ayudarnos a construir la marca más confiable del mundo.

Brief Job Description

As a Commercial Executive , you will play a pivotal role in driving business growth by identifying and engaging with potential business partners to expand OYO's presence in key markets. You will be responsible for developing and executing strategies to attract new properties, negotiate agreements, and drive adoption of the OYO OS model. Additionally, you will work closely with property owners to understand their needs, provide ongoing support, and ensure a seamless onboarding process.

Como Ejecutivo Comercial, jugarás un papel crucial en el impulso del crecimiento empresarial identificando y comprometiéndote con socios comerciales potenciales para expandir la presencia de OYO en mercados clave. Serás responsable de desarrollar y ejecutar estrategias para atraer nuevas propiedades, negociar acuerdos e impulsar la adopción del modelo OYO OS. Además, trabajarás estrechamente con los propietarios de propiedades para comprender sus necesidades, proporcionar apoyo continuo y asegurar un proceso de integración fluido.

Job Overview

The Commercial Executive will be primarily focused on business development initiatives, including prospecting, lead generation, and partnership building. You will leverage your strong communication and negotiation skills to cultivate relationships with property owners, drive adoption of OYO's products and services, and maximize revenue opportunities. In addition to expanding our network of properties, you will also collaborate with internal teams to develop and implement strategies to optimize the performance of existing properties.

El Ejecutivo Comercial se centrará en el desarrollo de negocios, incluyendo la prospección, generación de leads y construcción de asociaciones. Utilizarás tus fuertes habilidades de comunicación y negociación para cultivar relaciones con los propietarios de propiedades, impulsar la adopción de los productos y servicios de OYO y maximizar las oportunidades de ingresos. Además de expandir nuestra red de propiedades, también colaborarás con equipos internos para desarrollar e implementar estrategias que optimicen el rendimiento de las propiedades existentes.

Responsibilities

  • Identify, pursue, and move leads through the sales cycle to expand OYO's network of properties in target markets.
  • Develop and execute strategic business development plans to achieve growth objectives.
  • Negotiate agreements with property owners to onboard new properties onto the OYO platform.
  • Meet with customers/clients face to face & or over the phone.
  • Developing proposals for clients.
  • Provide ongoing support to property owners, including assistance with onboarding, training, and troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to develop and implement strategies to optimize property performance and drive revenue growth.
  • Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify opportunities for expansion and differentiation.
  • Coordinate pricing strategies with Revenue Managers
  • Ensure room availability (for selling) for the company.
  • Recovery of debt.
  • Churn prevention: Engage with partners to educate them around the solutions Oyo provides and reduce churn.
  • Partner Experience: Ensuring our partners are looked after is critical and so this role is responsible in supporting post onboarding to ensure brand standards, recon statements, commercial understanding (if any) and act as a support function for the partner.
  • Identificar, perseguir y avanzar leads a través del ciclo de ventas para expandir la red de propiedades de OYO en mercados objetivo.
  • Desarrollar y ejecutar planes estratégicos de desarrollo de negocio para alcanzar objetivos de crecimiento.
  • Negociar acuerdos con propietarios de propiedades para integrar nuevas propiedades a la plataforma OYO.
  • Reunirse con clientes cara a cara o por teléfono.
  • Desarrollar propuestas para clientes.
  • Proporcionar apoyo continuo a los propietarios de propiedades, incluyendo asistencia con la integración, capacitación y solución de problemas.
  • Colaborar con equipos internos para desarrollar e implementar estrategias que optimicen el rendimiento de las propiedades y fomenten el crecimiento de ingresos.
  • Monitorear las tendencias del mercado y la actividad de los competidores para identificar oportunidades de expansión y diferenciación.
  • Coordinar estrategias de precios con los Gerentes de Ingresos.
  • Asegurar la disponibilidad de habitaciones (para venta) para la empresa.
  • Recuperación de deudas.
  • Prevención de deserción: Interactuar con socios para educarlos sobre las soluciones que OYO ofrece y reducir la deserción.
  • Experiencia del Socio: Asegurar el bienestar de nuestros socios es crítico y, por tanto, este rol es responsable de apoyar después de la integración para asegurar estándares de marca, entendimientos comerciales y actuar como función de apoyo para el socio.


Job Experience

2-3 years of relevant experience in business development, sales, or related fields, preferably in Real Estate and Hospitality industries.

2-3 años de experiencia relevante en desarrollo de negocios, ventas o campos relacionados, preferiblemente en las industrias de Bienes Raíces y Hospitalidad.


Education

Language

  • Strong business development skills, with a proven track record of identifying and closing new business opportunities.

  • Strategic thinker with the ability to analyze market trends, identify opportunities, and develop actionable plans to drive growth.

  • Pensador estratégico con la habilidad de analizar tendencias del mercado, identificar oportunidades y desarrollar planes de acción para impulsar el crecimiento.

BRQ WAY

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!



  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


  • O que você deve ter?

Precisamos de um profissional PL auto-didata que conheça front-end e back-end, desejáveis React/Angular e Next.JS, Node.js e Python. O profissional vai trabalhar em conjunto com o time de IA do Fusion, deve conhecer as IDEs de mercado VS Code e Cursor e como utilizar IA, deve conhecer o uso de Prompts e RAG, e ter noção do que sao agentes de IA. Conhecimentos de banco de dados e cloud sao um diferencial. Fundamental ter conhecimentos de Design System e Figma.



O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas:

- Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

- Mobilidade Interna: Você quer um novo rumo profissional? Aqui dentro de casa temos diversas opções diferentes e o programa de mobilidade interna, que te permite mudar de área, por exemplo.

- Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

- Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

E os benefícios?

Somos parte de um grupo integrado de energia com operações globais, que abrange desde a exploração e produção de hidrocarbonetos até transporte, refinaria e comercialização. Além disso, estamos presentes em negócios de biocombustíveis e infraestruturas essenciais. Nosso objetivo é impulsionar a transição energética, reduzindo nossas emissões de carbono e contribuindo para um mundo mais sustentável, com a meta de atingir emissões líquidas zero até 2050.


Junte-se à Ecopetrol Brasil!


Estamos buscando um(a) Advogado(a) Pleno para atuar em modelo híbrido , em nosso escritório localizado em Botafogo – RJ .


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Assessorar a empresa em questões regulatórias junto à ANP, CNPE, MME e demais órgãos reguladores;
  • Apoiar na condução de processos administrativos regulatórios, incluindo cessões, atualizações cadastrais, submissão de documentos e diligências junto à ANP;
  • Analisar, revisar e elaborar contratos típicos do setor, como JOAs, SPAs, contratos de consórcio, concessão e partilha de produção, GSAs, GTAs, MOUs;
  • Revisar e aprimorar contratos corporativos padrão, manuais, políticas internas, mitigando riscos jurídicos;
  • Elaborar e revisar documentos legais e regulatórios do setor, incluindo licenças, certidões, contratos de exploração e produção e pareceres sobre normas de órgãos reguladores;
  • Preparar documentação para inscrição e qualificação em licitações e leilões da ANP, garantindo qualidade e cumprimento de prazos;
  • Prestar suporte legal contínuo às áreas corporativas, garantindo conformidade regulatória e corporativa;
  • Participar de fóruns da indústria, interagir com órgãos reguladores e apoiar na interface com escritórios de advocacia externos;
  • Apoiar controles internos e auditorias jurídicas, regulatórias e corporativas;
  • Identificar riscos legais e regulatórios, propor soluções preventivas e monitorar mudanças na legislação aplicável à indústria de exploração e produção.


Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Graduação em Direito;
  • Atuação comprovada em contratos corporativos;
  • Desejável experiência e conhecimento na indústria de óleo e gás;
  • Inglês avançado/fluente;
  • Espanhol será considerado diferencial.


Conhecimentos técnicos:


  • Sólido conhecimento da legislação brasileira, especialmente societária e corporativa;
  • Desejável conhecimento das normas e regulamentações aplicáveis à indústria de E&P;
  • Habilidade de análise, síntese e antecipação de riscos jurídicos e regulatórios.

title: Gerente de Obras Civis (Experiência em Projetos Industriais)
description:
Estamos em busca de um/a Gerente de Obras Civis, que será responsável pela execução civil de projetos petroquímicos, controlando interfaces, assegurando conformidade técnica, integridade estrutural, execução sequenciada e aderência a requisitos de segurança de processo. Este/a profissional atuará em uma de nossas obras na região do Rio de Janeiro/RJ, tendo estas atribuições principais:


  • Alinhar bases civis, estruturas, pipe-racks, utilidades e áreas de processo conforme sequenciamento eletromecânico e de instrumentação do projeto;
  • Conduzir reuniões técnicas multidisciplinares (Civil, Mecânica, Tubulação, E&I, Automação, SMS) para garantir a compatibilização de projetos e a antecipação de interferências críticas durante a execução das obras;
  • Validar soluções de projeto civil com foco nas necessidades específicas da planta, como cargas dinâmicas de equipamentos rotativos, vibração, fundações especiais para tanques e suportação de tubulações;
  • Controlar interfaces com montagens industriais, garantindo que as estruturas civis, bases e alinhamentos estejam liberados dentro do prazo para instalação de equipamentos críticos;
  • Gerenciar o desenvolvimento e atualização do ‘’As Built” civil sincronizado com alterações de campo, revisões de engenharia e modificações industriais (MOCs);
  • Acompanhar e validar ensaios e controles tecnológicos essenciais para áreas industriais, como ensaio de compactação, ensaios de integridade estrutural, controle de concretagem para bases de equipamentos e pavimentos industriais;
  • Integrar a obra civil aos requisitos de segurança de processo, garantindo atendimento a normas, zoneamentos, distanciamentos, contenções, bacias e drenagem industrial;
  • Gerenciar a interface com fornecedores e contratados, alinhando soluções técnicas e cronogramas para minimizar impactos entre civil, montagem eletromecânica e comissionamento;
  • Atuar em parceria com a área de Suprimentos, dimensionando corretamente a compra de materiais, prezando por custo e boa gestão de estoques;
  • Manter relacionamento produtivo e transparente com entidades sindicais e órgãos fiscalizadores, conhecendo a legislação trabalhista e convenção coletiva, preservando a segurança empresarial.


Perfil Requerido:

  • Formação Superior completa em Engenharia Civil;
  • Pós-Graduação e/ou MBA em Gerenciamento de Projetos, Gestão da Construção Civil, Segurança de Processos Industriais ou Gestão de Riscos;
  • Sólida experiência em obras do ramo industrial (plantas químicas, petroquímicas, siderúrgicas ou de processamento de gás, refinarias, termelétricas ou demais correlatas);
  • Amplo conhecimento das modalidades de contratos e subcontratos e suas implicações no andamento do projeto;
  • Conhecimentos acerca de metodologias 3D voltadas à modelagem e integração multidisciplinar (Civil, Mecânica, Tubulação, E&I);
  • Conhecimentos acerca dos principais softwares do Pacote Office, sobretudo Excel;
  • Disponibilidade / mobilidade para atuar em regime 100% presencial na região do Rio de Janeiro/RJ.



Sobre a Odebrecht:


A Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção é uma empresa que presta serviços nos segmentos de construção civil pesada e construção, montagem e manutenção de empreendimentos industriais, sediada no Brasil e atende além deste país, outros quatro mercados: Brasil, Angola e Estados Unidos. Composta por mais de 20 mil Integrantes, a Odebrecht gera oportunidades de trabalho para as populações locais e contribui para o desenvolvimento sustentável de cada região, atuando nas seguintes áreas:


✔ Transporte e Logística

✔ Energia

✔ Saneamento

✔ Engenharia Industrial

✔ Desenvolvimento Urbano e Edificações



Nossa Cultura:


A Nossa Cultura é um conjunto de princípios, conceitos e critérios, com foco na educação e no trabalho, que provê os fundamentos éticos, morais e conceituais para a atuação dos integrantes do Grupo. Valorizamos potencialidades do ser humano, como a disposição para servir, a capacidade e o desejo de evoluir e a vontade de superar resultados. Acreditamos, com convicção e determinação, que a prática da Cultura Odebrecht e das nossas políticas, com atuação ética, íntegra e transparente e o compromisso em promover a diversidade, nos fortalecem e aumentam a nossa competitividade, no rumo da sobrevivência, do crescimento e da perpetuidade.

Sobre a InBot:

Mais sobre nós:


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Arquitetura e Refinamento Técnico (Discovery → Delivery): Atuar junto às áreas de negócio e ao time técnico no levantamento, análise e refinamento de requisitos, traduzindo necessidades em especificações técnicas claras (user stories, critérios de aceite, regras de negócio, fluxos e integrações) e apoiando a definição da melhor arquitetura para entrega.


Gestão Técnica do Backlog: Apoiar a organização e priorização técnica das demandas, garantindo que as atividades estejam bem detalhadas, quebradas em entregas incrementais e com dependências mapeadas, reduzindo retrabalho e aumentando previsibilidade.


Definição de Solução e Padrões: Propor e documentar padrões técnicos, decisões de arquitetura (ADRs), contratos de API e boas práticas (observabilidade, versionamento, consistência de integrações, idempotência, retries, rate limit, etc.), garantindo escalabilidade e manutenibilidade.


Colaboração e Alinhamento Contínuo: Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis (refinamento, planning, review), contribuindo para clareza técnica, estimativas realistas e alinhamento entre produto, operações e desenvolvimento.


Qualidade e Segurança no Ciclo de Desenvolvimento: Reforçar práticas de code review, testes automatizados, análise estática e segurança (OWASP, gestão de segredos, IAM least privilege), garantindo qualidade do código e confiabilidade das entregas.


Uso de IA Generativa com Governança: Utilizar IA generativa para potencializar produtividade (análise de logs, geração/validação de testes, rascunho de documentação, scaffolding de código e refatorações assistidas), mantendo rigor em revisão humana, versionamento, padrões internos e práticas de segurança.


Mentoria e Multiplicação Técnica: Apoiar o desenvolvimento do time, com mentorias, revisão de PRs, suporte em decisões de design e disseminação de boas práticas para elevar o nível técnico do squad.


Desenvolvimento em Nuvem: Atuar em ambientes AWS (EC2, EKS, ECR, ACM, RDS), garantindo performance, escalabilidade e segurança.

Conteinerização e Orquestração: Implementar e gerenciar containers com Docker e Kubernetes (administração, criação de pods, serviços, ingress, etc.).

Integrações de Sistemas: Desenvolver integrações entre o assistente virtual e os sistemas dos clientes utilizando APIs REST e JSON, além de OpenAPI/Swagger.

Desenvolvimento Backend: Trabalhar principalmente com JavaScript, Node.js, Promises, HTML5, CSS e TypeScript para criar funcionalidades robustas e assíncronas de forma eficiente.

Autenticação e Segurança: Implementar autenticação com OIDC (OpenID Connect), SAML e aplicar práticas de desenvolvimento seguro.

Criação e Manutenção de APIs: Desenvolver APIs internas e externas com documentação clara e padronizada.

Gestão de Bancos de Dados: Criar, administrar e otimizar bancos relacionais e não relacionais (SQL, MongoDB, RDS na AWS).

Ambiente Linux: Gerenciar e configurar servidores Linux, utilizando Shell Script para automação.

Controle de Versões: Utilizar Git para versionamento de código, integração contínua e práticas de CI/CD.

Desenvolvimento de Relatórios: Criar queries e relatórios para produtos e serviços.

Boas Práticas: Aplicar Promises, testes automatizados, documentação de código e metodologias ágeis para garantir escalabilidade e qualidade.


Diferenciais:

Experiência com arquitetura orientada a eventos (filas, mensageria, processamento assíncrono) e padrões de resiliência.

Familiaridade com IA aplicada ao ciclo de desenvolvimento (ex.: geração de testes, revisão assistida, documentação automatizada) com governança e segurança.

Conhecimento em microserviços e arquitetura serverless.

Experiência com DevOps e ferramentas de CI/CD.

Familiaridade com IA Generativa para otimização de processos e experiência do usuário.

Conhecimento em arquitetura de sistemas (redes, firewalls, DNS, roteamento, modelagem de dados).

Experiência com Java ou Scala.

Desenvolvimento Full Stack: Atuar também em camadas de front-end sempre que necessário, garantindo a integração de ponta a ponta.


Requisitos e qualificações

Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência: Mínimo 5 anos comprovados em desenvolvimento, essencialmente com JavaScript e Node.js.

APIs REST e JSON

Promises e programação assíncrona em JavaScript

Práticas de desenvolvimento seguro e testes automatizados

title: LATAM-Focused Research Intern
description:
About BCP Securities Group

Founded in 1989, BCP Securities, Inc. is an American brokerage and investment bank focused on fixed income in emerging markets. Headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut, with offices in strategic cities such as Rio de Janeiro, Miami, Los Angeles, Madrid, Mexico City, and Singapore, BCP is a global reference in customized financial solutions. Recognized for its excellence and ethical commitment, the company offers innovative and effective services to meet the needs of clients around the world.

Workplace: Rio de Janeiro, 100% on-site Contract Type: Internship

Position Description

We are looking for a motivated and curious Research Intern to join our Research team, with a focus on Latin America’s, particularly Argentina’s, macroeconomic and financial environment . This position is ideal for students who are eager to learn and develop their skills in economic and financial research.

The selected candidate must be native or fluent in Spanish and English (mandatory) and will support the research team in conducting studies, preparing financial reports, and assisting senior analysts in day-to-day activities.


Please note: Resumes will only be accepted if written English. Applications submitted in Portuguese will not be considered.

Main Responsibilities

·      Support the preparation of financial reports on companies and the monitoring of key economic and financial indicators.

·      Assist in preparing summaries and basic analyses of market trends, economic projections, and corporate earnings.

·      Help monitor economic events, public policy changes, and macroeconomic data that may impact financial markets.

·      Track the performance and movements of financial assets.

·      Assist in the development of financial models for company valuation, under the guidance of senior analysts.

·      Support data collection, organization, and basic analysis.

·      Assist with administrative and operational tasks such as organizing meetings, reports, and presentation materials.

·      Collaborate in the preparation of materials for internal use and for investor or market communications.

Requirements

·      Fluent Spanish and fluent English (mandatory).

·      Currently pursuing a degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Accounting, or related fields.

·      Basic understanding of financial concepts such as financial statements, company valuation, and financial instruments.

·      Ability to read and interpret financial statements and corporate reports.

·      Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with attention to detail.

·      Good Excel skills (formulas, basic financial modeling).

·      Clear and structured written communication skills.

·      Willingness to learn, curiosity about financial markets, and interest in economic trends and global events.

Differentials

·      Previous internship or academic experience in finance, economics, or capital markets.

·      Familiarity with financial information platforms such as Bloomberg or Reuters.

·      Knowledge of basic programming or data analysis tools (e.g., Python, VBA, Power BI).

Benefits

·      Hands-on learning experience in a global company with a strong presence in the fixed income market.

·      Exposure to macroeconomic analysis, company research, and financial markets in LatAm.

·      Continuous learning, mentoring, and professional development.

·      Collaborative, dynamic, and supportive work environment.

title: Systems Engineer (Data Compression)
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


***

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.

We are looking for a Systems Engineer with deep experience in compression algorithms and high-performance systems.

You will work closely with the core engineering team to help analyze, validate, optimize, and productionize advanced lossless compression technology .

The ideal candidate is both technically rigorous and intellectually curious , capable of investigating unconventional approaches while applying strong systems engineering discipline.


What you'll work on

  • Designing and optimizing lossless compression techniques
  • Evaluating compression performance across different datasets
  • Improving throughput, compression ratio, and memory efficiency
  • Benchmarking and profiling performance-critical systems
  • Building high-performance libraries and services
  • Collaborating with engineers to productionize compression technology

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong programming skills in C++, Rust, C, or other systems languages
  • Experience with performance optimization and profiling
  • Solid understanding of algorithms and data structures
  • Experience building high-performance systems or infrastructure
  • Comfortable working with confidential technology under NDA

Nice to have

  • Experience with compression algorithms (LZ, Zstd, Huffman, Brotli, etc.)
  • Background in storage systems, distributed systems, or databases
  • Experience working at cloud providers or infrastructure companies
  • Experience with benchmarking or systems performance testing
  • Familiarity with AI / GenAI development tools


Benefits

title: AI Video Editor
description:
Hiring: AI Video Editor / Performance Videographer

Company: Rain Media

Reports to: Creative Director

Status: Full-time Contractor (Global)

Location: Argentina and Brazil, preferred


Position Overview

Are You a Performance-Driven Video Editor Who Knows How to Turn Creative Into Conversions? If you think in hooks, pacing, and paid social performance, and you’re already leveraging AI video tools to produce faster, smarter creative, this role is for you.

At Organics Ocean, we’re looking for an AI-native Video Editor / Performance Videographer who will help scale high-volume direct response creative. This role exists to solve a key business need: increasing creative output, improving execution speed, and reducing revision cycles while elevating the quality of edits through advanced AI workflows.

This is a production-first role focused primarily on editing, post-production, and AI-enhanced creative, not traditional filming.

You will work closely with Creative, Growth, and Marketing partners to deliver performance-focused assets that directly impact campaign velocity.


Who we are: Organics Ocean

We are a premium direct-to-consumer supplement brand helping people live healthier lives through science-backed, clean, and effective products.

We’re not a company where things stay the same. We test, we optimize, we innovate—and we want someone who thrives in that kind of high-accountability, fast-paced environment.


Why join our team?


High-growth eCommerce brand: Driven by innovation and fast execution, Organics Ocean has seen 350% year over year growth.


Ownership & Accountability: We trust our team members to take full ownership of their responsibilities. You are empowered to lead, execute, and improve without micromanagement. We value individuals who take initiative, hold themselves accountable, and drive meaningful results.


A team of high performers: We push boundaries, move fast, and get things done. The company is in a hockey stick growth phase. This is not a good fit for those who don’t want to grow.


Responsibilities

Direct Response Video Editing

  • Produce high-quality paid social performance creatives
  • Execute UGC edits, AI creative, AI UGC, mini-VSL, and VSL formats
  • Optimize pacing, hooks, and CTAs for conversion
  • Deliver high output with minimal revision cycles

AI Video Workflow Integration

  • Use AI tools to accelerate production and improve quality
  • Create both AI-forward and AI-assisted realistic creatives
  • Continuously test new AI workflows to improve performance

Creative Collaboration

  • Partner with Creative Strategy to execute briefs
  • Attend creative meetings to reduce revision loops
  • Align closely with Creative leadership on feedback

Production & Workflow Support

  • Act as a point of contact between Creative Lead and external editors
  • Help disseminate process updates and feedback to contractors
  • Support operational efficiency and creative throughput

Filming (Secondary Responsibility)

  • Occasional product shots or B-roll when needed


What success looks like


First 90 Days

  • Fully ramp into Rain Media’s performance creative workflow and AI editing stack
  • Deliver consistent weekly output aligned to creative briefs and paid social requirements
  • Demonstrate proficiency using required AI tools within real production workflows
  • Reduce revision cycles by actively participating in creative meetings and feedback loops
  • Establish clear collaboration rhythms with Creative leadership and external editors
  • Begin contributing process improvements that increase speed and execution quality

In 12 months:

  • Consistently deliver 15–20 high-performing creatives per week with strong execution speed
  • Become a key leverage point for creative production, supporting communication with external editors and improving workflow efficiency
  • Elevate overall creative quality through advanced AI integration and experimentation
  • Maintain a standard of ≤1 revision cycle between strategy and editing whenever possible
  • Help scale creative volume without sacrificing performance or brand quality
  • Contribute to evolving Rain Media’s AI-first creative production framework


Requirements

Requirements (Expected Proficiencies to Excel in This Role)

  • Ability to communicate (speak/write) fluent English
  • 2 + yrs proven experience editing direct response performance creatives for paid social platforms (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, etc.)
  • Must have AI video experience and samples to showcase your work
  • Strong understanding of conversion-focused editing, including hooks, pacing, storytelling, and call-to-action structure
  • Demonstrated ability to produce high-volume creative output in a fast-paced, test-and-learn environment
  • Hands-on experience using AI video generation and enhancement tools within production workflows
  • Proficiency with core editing platforms such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or equivalent
  • Working knowledge of creative design tools such as Canva, Photoshop, or Figma
  • Experience collaborating closely with creative strategists, growth teams, or performance marketing teams
  • Ability to interpret creative briefs and execute with minimal revision cycles
  • Strong communication skills and comfort participating in real-time feedback sessions
  • Ability to manage multiple creative experiments simultaneously while maintaining speed and quality

AI & Technical Proficiency (Required)

  • Experience working with tools such as Higgsfield, Google V3/Gemini workflows , or similar AI-driven platforms
  • Understanding of AI-assisted editing techniques, including both overt AI creative and realistic AI integrations

Nice-to-Have Proficiencies

  • Experience with advanced AI platforms such as Sora, Kling , or emerging generative video tools
  • Familiarity with open-source AI workflows or technical experimentation across AI ecosystems
  • Background supporting or coordinating external video editors or creative contractors

Additional Requirements

  • Willingness to work within US time zones (Eastern preferred)
  • Access to a work computer, a reliable internet connection and a distraction-free workspace
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response and AI-enhanced video work


Offer Details

Compensation: Contractor compensation will be aligned to regional market benchmarks based on the candidate’s country of residence and expressed as monthly salary ranges.


About Organics Ocean

To learn the founder’s story and more about Organics Ocean, visit the website.

The company is a place for innovation. Team roles and responsibilities are clear, and the passion for being a part of something bigger than oneself is shared by everyone. The environment is casual, but the work is serious. Riding this wave of growth only works with A-Players on the team, and that is what everyone is: an A-Player.


Cultural Pillars:

  • Accountability : Take full ownership of your responsibilities and their outcomes. You commit to seeing tasks through, accepting both successes and failures as your own, and continuously learning and improving along the way.
  • Operational Excellence: We believe a strong Foundation is a scalable business. In e-commerce, every action becomes a building block and small cracks compound quickly as we grow. We prioritize building reliable processes, systems, and standards that hold up under scale. We fix breakdowns early, design for consistency, and execute with discipline so growth doesn't introduce chaos.
  • Clarity & Trust: Clarity builds trust, and it goes both ways. Leaders are responsible for setting clear expectations, priorities, and context. Team members are responsible for asking questions, raising their hands, and seeking clarity when something is unclear. When clarity is actively given an actively sought, trust grows, decisions improve, and the teams move faster together.
  • Efficient Leverage: Efficient leverage means doing the right work, not more work. We challenge the status quo, explore better ways of working, and speak up when we see opportunities to improve. We value fresh thinking, but apply it with intention, building systems, making decisions, and creating leverage that drives meaningful impact. Through innovation paired with discipline, we pull the right levers to move the business forward and scale sustainably.
  • Move Fast and Persevere: We push forward with speed and determination, even when things get tough. In the fast-paced world of e-commerce and startups, challenges are inevitable. Success comes from acting quickly, adapting, and staying resilient when obstacles arise. We don’t slow down when things get hard—we press through and keep moving forward.

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

  • Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels.

  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable).
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting).

Preferred Qualifications

title: Brand & Copy Strategist
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a Brand & Copy Strategist!


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


Purpose of This Position


As a Brand & Copy Strategist, you are responsible for writing and owning all copy for the clients within your squad, ensuring that every word reflects the brand’s voice, positioning, and intent.

You ensure that every piece of written content across websites, social media, email, and campaigns is on-brand, intentional, and delivered at a high standard. You bring together copywriting, brand awareness, practical content direction, strategy, and project management to ensure brands are represented clearly and consistently through words.


You act as the bridge between brand intent and execution, translating client goals and direction into clear, purposeful copy that is ready for internal review and client delivery.


Core Responsibility


Serve as the owner of brand representation through copy for your squad’s clients. Your accountability is defined by the following questions:

  • “Is this copy clear, on-brand, purposeful, and strong enough to confidently move forward?”
  • \"Is this project timeline possible with the resources we have for proper execution?”


Main Objectives


1. Content Execution & Copywriting

  • Write high-quality, purpose-driven copy for:
  • -Websites
  • -Social media captions and post copy
  • -Email campaigns
  • -Campaign and promotional assets
  • Design-related copy (headlines, CTAs, supporting text)
  • Act as the primary writer for all copy deliverables within your squad.
  • Ensure every piece of copy is written with intention, clarity, and audience awareness.
  • Perform copyediting on your own work to maintain consistency, grammatical excellence, and brand alignment, using tools and peers as needed.


2. Strategy & Project Management

  • Create social media strategies for your clients based on their goals and audiences
  • Keep track of client feedback and apply them to future work
  • Plan content in batches for the month, ensuring:
  • -Consistency in writing style
  • -Variety in content types
  • -A range of related, engaging topics


3. Social Media Copy & Content Direction

  • Develop and write social media copy that reflects the brand’s voice and messaging.
  • When appropriate, define content themes and messaging direction for social platforms.
  • When deeper strategy or clarity is required, collaborate with Special Teams to receive social content strategy support or plans.
  • Execute all social media copy in alignment with the strategy you create and flag any gaps or unclear direction early.


4. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency

  • Participate in brainstorming and ideation sessions to help define the content, messaging, and assets required for campaigns and initiatives.
  • Provide copy-led input on creative direction to ensure consistency of brand voice, messaging, and intent across all touchpoints.
  • Collaborate with designers, Marketing Coordinators, and Account Managers to align written and visual assets under a cohesive brand narrative.
  • Contribute perspective beyond copy when needed to maintain brand clarity and consistency.


5. Brand Advocacy

  • Act as the copy owner for each assigned brand, ensuring consistent voice, tone, and messaging across all written content.
  • Apply brand guidelines and positioning directly within copy execution.
  • Review copy deliverables to ensure they meet internal quality standards and accurately represent the brand’s intent.


Reporting Relationship

  • This role reports to the designated Account Manager of your squad.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


1. Brand Alignment & Copy Effectiveness

  • Ensure all copy deliverables are consistently aligned with the brand’s voice, tone, and messaging.
  • Maintain minimal client revisions related to brand alignment, tone, or clarity.
  • Contribute social content ideas and messaging angles when needed, ensuring alignment with the brand’s voice, positioning, and goals.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure brand consistency across copy and supporting assets.


2. Content Quality & Accuracy

  • Deliver copy that meets internal quality standards for clarity, structure, and purpose.
  • Maintain a low rate of client dissatisfaction related to copy quality or intent.


3. Project Delivery Timeliness

  • Deliver copy-related tasks within agreed timelines.
  • Collaborate with the squad to support smooth handoffs and on-time delivery of content assets.


Work Details

  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Senior Business/System Analyst (Disaster Recovery)
description:

Vuori is re-defining what athletic apparel looks like: built to move and sweat in but designed with a casual aesthetic to transition into everyday life. Our high-energy, fast-paced office environment is reflected in the clothes we make. We aim to inspire others to take on all aspects of their lives with clarity, enthusiasm, and purpose…. while having a lot of fun along the way. Overview

We are seeking a contract Business Analyst to support the development and execution of our Disaster Recovery (DR) Program. This role will help establish structure, documentation, and repeatable processes to ensure our DR efforts are organized, testable, and aligned with business needs.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop the overall structure and framework for the Disaster Recovery Program, including roles, responsibilities, and governance.
  • Create and refine documentation such as DR runbooks, process flows, and system recovery procedures.
  • Partner with technical teams to capture system dependencies, failover steps, testing requirements, and validation criteria.
